```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("dashboard-setup.R")
```

Many packages extend Shiny with page layouts, inputs, outputs, notifications or javascript tools.
This page lists the ones rvis dashboards support today, the ones they can use without changes,
and the ones that could be supported by new item types, with what that would take.

## Supported packages

| Package | Supported through |
|:---|:---|
| [shiny](https://shiny.posit.co/) | all standard inputs and outputs, `fluidPage`, `sidebarLayout`, `navbarPage`, `navbarMenu`, `tabsetPanel`, `navlistPanel`, `tabPanel`, `conditionalPanel`, `wellPanel`, `column`, plot interactions, download buttons |
| [shinydashboard](https://rstudio.github.io/shinydashboard/) | `dashboardPage` (header style), `sidebarMenu`, `menuItem`, `menuSubItem`, `tabItems`, `tabItem`, `box`, value and info boxes (outputs and clothes) |
| [shinyBS](https://ebailey78.github.io/shinyBS/) | `bsModal`, `bsCollapse`, `bsCollapsePanel`, tooltips and popovers of any item |
| [shinyWidgets](https://dreamrs.github.io/shinyWidgets/) | `actionBttn`, `actionGroupButtons`, `airDatepickerInput`, plot spinners |
| [shinyjs](https://deanattali.com/shinyjs/) | methods `hideItems()`, `showItems()`, `enableItems()`, `disableItems()`; any shinyjs function in services |
| [rintrojs](https://carlganz.github.io/rintrojs/) | guided tours: `tutor.lesson` of any item, `tutorBox` |
| [DT](https://rstudio.github.io/DT/) | `dataTableOutput` with DataTables options |
| [bcrypt](https://github.com/jeroen/bcrypt) | encrypted passwords of the login table |
| htmlwidgets | 23 output types: highcharter, plotly, dygraphs, leaflet, rAmCharts, billboarder, c3, morrisjs, d3plus, bubbles, networkD3, sankeytreeR, wordcloud2, sunburstR, upsetjs, rpivotTable, rhandsontable, googleVis, rCharts and the widgets embedded in rvis (TFD3, coffeewheel, grviz); see the [item reference](dashboard-reference.html#widgets) |

## Packages usable without changes

These packages work in configurations as they are: their functions are called in services,
the prescript, observers, `!expr` values or `static` items.

| Package | How |
|:---|:---|
| [shinythemes](https://rstudio.github.io/shinythemes/) | `theme: !expr shinythemes::shinytheme("flatly")` of a `navbarPage`, `fluidPage` or `sidebarLayout`; theme selector as a static item `object: !expr shinythemes::themeSelector()` |
| [bslib](https://rstudio.github.io/bslib/) | `theme: !expr bslib::bs_theme(bootswatch = "minty")` of a page |
| shiny notifications, modal dialogs, progress | `showNotification()`, `showModal(modalDialog(...))`, `withProgress()` in services ([gallery](dashboard-gallery.html#modal-dialog)) |
| [shinyalert](https://github.com/daattali/shinyalert), [sweetalert of shinyWidgets](https://dreamrs.github.io/shinyWidgets/) | `shinyalert::shinyalert(...)`, `shinyWidgets::sendSweetAlert(session, ...)` in services |
| [markdown](https://github.com/rstudio/markdown) | `object: !expr shiny::includeMarkdown("about.md")` in a static item |
| any htmlwidget | a `dynamicInput` whose service returns the widget (rendered by `renderUI()`), or `htmlOutput` |
| any input function | a `dynamicInput` returning the input (its value is `input$<id>`) or a static item `object: !expr pkg::someInput("id", ...)` |

## Packages that could be supported {#candidates}

These need new item types in `dashboard.R`: the input or output function in `getItemObject()` or
`outputObject()`, the render function in `outputScript()`, and their names in
`valid.input.types`, `valid.output.types` or `valid.container.types`.

| Package | Items | Effort | Notes |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| [shinyWidgets](https://dreamrs.github.io/shinyWidgets/) | `pickerInput`, `switchInput`, `materialSwitch`, `prettyCheckbox`, `prettyRadioButtons`, `radioGroupButtons`, `checkboxGroupButtons`, `sliderTextInput`, `noUiSliderInput`, `knobInput`, `searchInput`, `dropdownButton`, `progressBar` | small | inputs with the same `choices`/`selected` settings as shiny inputs; the most useful next step |
| [bslib](https://rstudio.github.io/bslib/) | `page_sidebar`, `page_navbar`, `card`, `value_box`, `layout_columns`, `accordion` | medium | modern Bootstrap 5 pages and cards; containers like `box` and `dashboardPage` |
| [bs4Dash](https://bs4dash.rinterface.com/) | `dashboardPage` (Bootstrap 4), `bs4Card`, `bs4ValueBox`, `tabItems` | medium | similar to shinydashboard, with more box options |
| [shinydashboardPlus](https://rinterface.github.io/shinydashboardPlus/) | `box` options (sidebar, dropdown), user boxes, right sidebar | small | extends the current shinydashboard items |
| [waiter](https://waiter.john-coene.com/), [shinycssloaders](https://github.com/daattali/shinycssloaders) | `spinner` setting for all outputs | small | the current spinner only applies to `plotOutput` |
| [reactable](https://glin.github.io/reactable/) | `reactableOutput` | small | interactive tables |
| [timevis](https://daattali.com/shiny/timevis-demo/) | `timevisOutput` | small | timelines |
| [sortable](https://rstudio.github.io/sortable/) | `rank_list`, `bucket_list` inputs | small | drag and drop ordering (instead of sortableR) |
| [shinyFiles](https://github.com/thomasp85/shinyFiles) | `shinyFilesButton`, `shinyDirButton` | medium | server-side file selection; needs `shinyFileChoose()` in the server (could be generated) |
| [colourpicker](https://github.com/daattali/colourpicker) | `colourInput` | small | colour input |
| [shinyAce](https://github.com/trestletech/shinyAce) | `aceEditor` | small | code editor input |
| [shinyFeedback](https://merlinoa.github.io/shinyFeedback/), [shinyvalidate](https://rstudio.github.io/shinyvalidate/) | `validate` rules of inputs | medium | input validation messages from the configuration |
| [shinymanager](https://datastorm-open.github.io/shinymanager/) | secure login for the whole app | medium | an alternative to the login item |
| [cicerone](https://cicerone.john-coene.com/) | guided tours | small | an alternative to rintrojs |
| [shiny.i18n](https://appsilon.github.io/shiny.i18n/) | translated titles | medium | titles could be translation keys |
| [shinyjqui](https://yang-tang.github.io/shinyjqui/) | `draggable`, `resizable`, `sortable` settings of any item | small | jQuery UI interactions, like tooltips are added to any item |
| [shiny.semantic](https://appsilon.github.io/shiny.semantic/) | Fomantic UI pages and inputs | large | a different css framework: a parallel set of item types |
| [rhandsontable](https://jrowen.github.io/rhandsontable/) | editable table synced with `sync` | small | the output is supported; syncing edits like TFD3 tables would need observers |

## The example files of the user {#user-examples}

The `shiny_examples` folder of the rvis repository has examples of Shiny packages. This is how
they map to rvis dashboards:

| Example | rvis dashboard |
|:---|:---|
| `bscollapse_example.R`, `bsmodal_example.R`, `tooltip_example.R`, `popover_example.R` | supported: `bsCollapse`, `bsModal`, `tooltip`, `popover` ([example](dashboard-reference.html#shinybs)) |
| `gettablemodal_example.R` | supported: `build.container.get.table()` returns the items of a dialog reading a CSV table |
| `rintrojs_example_1.R` to `_3.R` | supported: `tutor.lesson`, `tutorBox` ([example](dashboard-reference.html#tutor)) |
| `modalDialog.R`, `showNotification.R`, `progressbar.R` | usable in services ([modal dialog](dashboard-gallery.html#modal-dialog), [progress](dashboard-gallery.html#progress)) |
| `shinythemes.R`, `themeSelector.R` | usable: `theme: !expr shinythemes::shinytheme(...)`, static theme selector ([example](dashboard-gallery.html#shinythemes)) |
| `scrollable_panel.R` | supported: box cloth with `height` and `style: "overflow-y: scroll"` |
| `shinywidgets_examples.R` | partly supported (`actionBttn`, `actionGroupButtons`, `airDatepickerInput`, spinners); more shinyWidgets inputs are candidates (see above) |
| `shinyFiles_example.R` | candidate (server-side file choosers) |
| `sortableR_examples.R` | candidate, with package sortable (sortableR is no longer maintained) |
| `shinySky_example.R` | not recommended: package shinysky is no longer maintained; its inputs exist in shinyWidgets |
| `links.R` (reference links) | next/previous buttons: `updateItem4Session()` on a `navbarPage`, `navlistPanel` or `sidebarMenu` (a `tabsetPanel` has no id yet); shinyjs and shinyWidgets: see above; semi-collapsible sidebar: shinydashboard sidebars collapse with the header button; shinyjqui and shiny.semantic: candidates (see above) |
